redaction: Allowlisted fields only; no private absolute paths, endpoints, hostnames, GPU UUIDs, PIDs, allocator/capture bindings or source snapshots. Grouped original monotonic block times retained; nongrouped wall-clock block timestamps omitted, original order and ranges retained.
reproduction: Requires the external xcheck corpus and formal drivers, matching dependencies, independent before/after environments and corresponding measured dirty sources. The exports preserve raw timing, shapes and selected correctness summaries, not a self-contained replay of lifecycle oracles.
resource_scope: Observed nongrouped objects: no increased dynamic SMEM, static SMEM 1024 bytes, frame/stack 0, no LDL/STL. Positive GPR deltas remain; all corresponding measured phases pass. Not a census of all production objects.
